note: City of Manchester campground in Governor's Park on Beech Creek Road, beside small Beech Creek Lake (fishing, small craft). Playground, basketball court, gaga pit and two covered pavilions. The park holds events on holiday weekends, when the campground is often full. No rate is posted; call for rates. --Claude
summary: Kept (local, no price gate). City of Manchester: 24 full-hookup concrete pads + 8 W/E (count 75 -> 32), dump, laundry, store; open year round; reservations by phone; no rate posted anywhere. Google 4.2/44. Pin ~365 m off -> 37.1709,-83.7119.

Esri imagery shows the gravel campground loop with RVs at ~37.1709,-83.7119 (east of the park's paved lot and courts, north of the ballfields). Suggest location -> 37.1709,-83.7119.
SITES: count 75 -> 32. The city lists only '24 sites–Full hook ups with concrete' and '8 sites– Water and Electric Only'; the stored 75 ('rest primitive') appears on no official page.
FEES: no rate posted on the city page ('For additional info concerning rates and reservations contact 606-598-1554'). Local, no price gate.
HOOKUPS: amperage not stated by the city; electric left unset.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept. Beech Creek Lake is a small pond-sized lake north-east of the loop, not at the pads.
